_note: Static domain priors prepended to every extraction prompt. Concept categories anchor the LLM to copolymer-relevant vocabulary; ontology anchors reference established polymer ontologies (PMDco, MaterialsMine, ChEBI, ChEMINF). Edit this file to steer extraction without code changes.

ontology_anchors.PMDco: Platform Materials Data ontology - core classes: Material, Process, Property, Method, Manufacturing.
ontology_anchors.MaterialsMine: NIST-aligned polymer KG vocabulary - emphasises polymer composition, processing, and characterization.
ontology_anchors.ChEBI: Chemical Entities of Biological Interest - useful for small-molecule monomers and reagents.
ontology_anchors.ChEMINF: Chemical information ontology - covers descriptors, identifiers, measured quantities.

extraction_guidance: Prefer specific names over generic phrases (e.g. 'poly(styrene-co-methyl methacrylate)' over 'a copolymer').
Capture numeric values WITH their units (e.g. 'Mn = 24,500 g/mol', 'Tg = 105 °C').
When a property is reported, link it to the material it characterises via 'hasProperty' and to the method that measured it via 'characterisedBy'.
Skip generic boilerplate (acknowledgements, references, figure captions without data).
If a fact is present in the chunk but not specific (e.g. 'high yield'), record it but mark numeric_value: null.
